If you feel like your marriage isn't going well and you're tired of it, there are several steps you can take to improve the situation. First, try talking to your husband about your feelings; sometimes just expressing how you feel can be beneficial.

If that doesn't help, consider taking some time apart from each other for a while. This might give you both a chance to think things through and possibly make changes that will benefit both of you. Just be sure to communicate what you need to feel better.

Lastly, always remember that every relationship takes effort and time. If you don't put in the effort, things may not get better on their own. So it's important to stay active and engaged in improving your situation if you want to see any real change.
